title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities. However, we identify two phenomena that question this channel. Invisible Advantage: a skill in context lifts WebShop success from 42.2% to 56.2%, yet changes the probabilities of fewer than a quarter of the sampled tokens. Much to Align: a skill changes the hidden states of over 80% of response tokens, in a way that linear probes can trace back to the specific skill. To exploit this, we propose Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation (PR-OPD). translated_title: PR-OPD：面向智能体强化学习的特权表征在线策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体通常通过强化学习进行训练，每个回合只获得一次奖励。特权自蒸馏对此进行了丰富，即让同一个策略在给定技能（skill）提示的条件下，通过 token 概率来教导其无技能的自我。然而，我们发现了两个质疑这一信息传递渠道的现象。隐形优势：在上下文中提供技能可以将 WebShop 的成功率从 42.2% 提升到 56.2%，但只改变了不到四分之一的采样 token 的概率。大量对齐空间：技能会改变超过 80% 的响应 token 的隐藏状态，并且线性探针能够将这些变化追溯回具体的技能。为了利用这一点，我们提出了特权表征在线策略自蒸馏（PR-OPD）。在 GRPO 热身启动之后，策略为每条轨迹撰写一个事后技能，并以该技能作为停止梯度的教师重新读取自己的响应，在奖励目标之外，于每一层将其投影后的隐藏状态与教师的隐藏状态进行对齐。
tldr: 该论文发现技能对语言模型智能体的增益主要体现在隐藏状态而非 token 概率的变化上，据此提出 PR-OPD 方法，在 GRPO 强化学习基础上让策略以事后技能作为停止梯度教师、逐层对齐隐藏状态，从而更充分地利用特权信息提升智能体性能。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that a skill's advantage for language-model agents manifests mainly in hidden states rather than token probability changes, and proposes PR-OPD, which builds on GRPO by letting the policy act as its own stop-gradient teacher conditioned on a hindsight skill and aligning hidden states layer by layer to fully exploit privileged information.
